tei:div.tei:p: (1na)rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ snyan brgyud brjed byang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)na mo gu ru/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i gsung sgros rgya mtsho lta bu la// bdag blo'i nus pas chu thig tsam pa ste// brjed kyis dogs nas dran pa gso phyir bris// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ dpal nā ro pa chen po'i gdams pa/ rje btsun la zhus pa'i dus su/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bla ma chen po nā ro pas// gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge bdun// 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa yis// sa rnams g.yos shing lung bstan thob// shar phyogs ngos kyi tai lo pa'i// zhal sngar gdams ngag mnos pa ni// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes gsungs pa de la gnad rnam pa gsum/ lus kyi gnad/ yul gyi gnad dang*/ dus kyi gnad do// de la lus kyi gnad bshad pa/ rkang pa re'u mig ltar bsnol/ sgal pa chu shing snying po ltar drang ba/ mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar dgug pa/ mnyam (2na)bzhag gi phyag rgya lte ba'i 'og tu shin tu btsir ba/ dpung pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'o// yul gyi gnad ni/ spyir mang yang*/ 'khor lo bzhi la gtad pa'am/ chags can yin na/ las kyi phyag rgya la gtad pa yang lugs gcig yin/ bla ma ni/ lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi mar 'jal ba'i sar/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdor gtum mo khab tsam la shes pa gtad pa'am/ yang na shes pa phyag rgya chen po la gtad nas/ rlung bsgom pa yin gsung*/ dus kyi gnad ni/ tha mal gyi dus lte bar shes pa gtad/ gnyid kyi dus snying khar gtad/ rmi lam gyi dus su mgrin par gtad/ snyoms 'jug gi dus spyi bor shes pa gtad/ tha mal gtum mo bsgom pa'i dus su/ lus gnad bcas nas/ rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// mda' ltar 'phang dang rnam pa bzhi// de la rngub pa ni/ sna bug gnyis rlung gis non pa yin/ dgang ba ni/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis dgang ba yin/ gzhil ba ni/ (2ba)rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rlung lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi 'jal ba'i sa na yar song bar bsam nas thub tshad mnan no// mi thub na/

se gol tog pa tsam re yang na gzhil ba ni/ tsha na byung na nyi ma gnyis gnyis tsam glod pa yin gsung*/ gtong ba yin/ de nas rlung gi mda' ltar 'phang ba ni/ dhū ti nas tshangs bug na yar rgyangs kyis song bar sems pa yin/ yang na lcags kyu ltar dgug par bya ba rtsa gnyis kyis rlung chir gyis mnan nas/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rtsar song nas dhū ti'i nang na yar song bar bsam nas gnon pa yin/ yang na thun stod la me la dmigs pa gtad nas/ thun smad la phyag rgya chen po la gtod pa yin gsung*/ de la bum pa rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ rab kyi mgrin pa man chad non pa yin/ 'bring snying ga man chad/ tha ma lte ba man chad non pa yin/ theg le 'chor na 'og sgo 'then pa yin/ bde ba shas che bar 'dod na yang 'og sgo 'then pa yin/ rlung bsgoms pas mgo bo la sogs pa na na/ lte ba man chad stong sang nge bzhag nas/ de man chad gnon pa yin/ rlung byang nas/ res steng rlung gnon/ res 'og rlung 'then nas/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa shas che ba yin/ de ltar bsgoms pas rtags lnga/ phan yon brgyad/ ye shes gsum la sogs pa 'byung ste/ byung yang sems nyid ma bcos pa la nges shes skyes na/ de rnams kyis mi phan te/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa gar skye cha med pa yin/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sdong po yin te 'bras bu min// yon tan yin te rtogs med min// gsung*/ 'od gsal la nges nas gtum mo yang phyag rgya chen po dang ma bral bar bsgom ste/ lus gnad bcas nas/ shes pa ma bcos par bzhag ste rlung bsgom pa yin/ gtum mo zhal (3na)gyi gdams pa las// gzhan phan bsam pas brjed byang bris// bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol// dge rtsa bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro ba'i don rnams 'grub par shog// /na mo gu ru/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ rmi lam la don bzhi yin/ rmi lam bzung ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ sgyu mar byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/

de kho na nyid bsgoms pa'o// de la bzung ba ni/ do nub rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya ste/ de yang ngo mtshar can gyi rmi lam rmi bar bya/ yi dam gyi zhal mthong ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mthong ba'am/ sum cu rtsa gsum du 'gro ba'am/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar can gyi rmi lam rmi bar bya'o// snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang la/ de nas mgrin par padma 'dab ma bzhi pa cig gi dbus su oṃ bsam la/ de la shes pa ma yengs par gtad la gnyid log /yang na smin phrag tu thig le la shes pa gtad la gnyid log /de nas gnyid sad pa dang*/ da ci bar yang rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo ma shes/ da res ni cis kyang ngo shes par bya snyam du bsams la gnyid log go /nyin mo bsgom pa'i dus na yang*/ rmi lam na bsgom pa yin snyam du rmi lam du sems shing*/ mig gis gzugs mthong ba la sogs pa/ snang srid 'di rnams rmi lam yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang nas bsgoms pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam zin pa'i rtags su chu chen po la mchong ba dang*/ g.yang la 'gro ba dang*/ khyis ded pa dang*/ rang gi lus la 'od 'byung ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam 'byung ngo*// de ltar byung nas rmi lam zin nas/ 'dun pa ma btang bar thams cad rmi lam du shes pa 'byung ba ni (3ba)rmi lam zin pa'o// de nas rmi lam sbyang ba ni/ rmi lam du chu chen po la sogs pa mi 'tsham pa sna tshogs 'byung ste/ chu la rgal ba dang*/ mer mchong ba dang*/ ri la sogs pa la thogs pa med par 'gro ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad blta ba dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin nas der bsgom pa dang*/ mgon po byams pa'i zhal blta ba dang*/ rgya gar thams cad blta ba dang*/ nyi zla rdog pas gnon pa la sogs pa rang gi sems la ci bsam pa thams cad bya'o// de ltar chur mchong ba la sogs pa nyam nga bag tsha byung na/ rmi lam yin/

sgyu ma yin/ mi bden pas ci ltar byas pas btub pa yin snyam pas/ sems kyis ci bsam pa thams cad bya'o// de ltar rmi lam yin pas/ rnam par rtog pa yin snyam du bsam nas/ sems bskyed bsgom mo// de yang rtog pa med pa'i gang zag gis kyang*/ mos pa byed pa yin no// de ltar rmi lam sbyangs pas/ gang zag cig rmi lam gyi sgo nas sangs rgya ba de lam cig yin no// rmi lam lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams ngag go// /bla ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams la gus par spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bar do rnam pa gsum la skye shi bar do ni/ skyes nas ma shi bar de yin/ rmi lam bar do ni/ rmi lam rmis nas ma sad kyi bar de yin/ srid pa bar do ni/ shi nas ma skyes kyi bar de yin/ skye shi bar dor bskyed rdzogs gnyis goms par byas pas/ rmi lam bar dor brtan nas 'ong*/ de nas srid pa bar do ni/ bar do dang por 'od gsal ngos bzung ba dang*/ gnyis pa sgyu lus sbyang ba dang*/ gsum pa mngal sgo 'gegs pa'o// de la dang po 'od gsal ngos bzung ba ni/ dang po 'byung ba bzhi las bskyed pa'i lus 'di 'jig pa'i dus su byung ba rim gyis bsdus (4na)te/ 'od gsal la goms pa cig gis/ de'i dus 'od gsal las ma yengs par byas la/ thams cad sems su shes par bya/ dang po sa chu la thim pa'i rtags su/ lus kyi zungs mi thub/ chu me la thim pa'i dus su kha sna skam/ me rlung la thim pa'i dus su/ lus kyi yan lag na rtsa sdud drod 'chor/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i dus su/ nang dbugs chad/ de tsa na snang ba mched pa/ snang ba thob pa 'od gsal te/ de la snang ba'i rtags su/ phyi rtags zla ba shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags du ba blta bu'o// snang ba mched pa'i rtags su/ phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags srin bu me khyer lta bu'o// snang ba thob pa'i rtags su/ phyi rtags su mun 'thibs pa lta bu/ nang rtags mar me lta bu'o// snang ba nye bar thob pa'i rtags su/

phyi rtags skya rengs shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags sprin med pa'i nam mkha' stong pa lta bu'o// de 'od gsal ba'o// de ltar 'od gsal gnyis 'dres pas/ gang zag dbang po rab tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya ba'o// de ltar yin par/ 'od gsal ba ni rgyun par gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes gsungs so/// /bar do gnyis pa sgyu lus la gnyis/ dag pa'i sgyu lus dang*/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus so// shi nas zhag phyed dang bzhi tshun chad/ dang po'i lus de nyid kyi 'dun pa dang ma bral bas/ de la brten nas 'od gsal bsgom pa ni/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus so// de gnyis ka yang sbyong byed 'od gsal gyi ye shes kyis/ sbyang gzhi bag chags sbyong ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas pa de slob pa'o// de'i dus su bag chags sbyong ba'i 'dun pa med par 'od gsal gyi ngang du song ba de ni mi slob pa'o// de gnyis ka zhag bzhi'am bdun tshun chad du dka' ba (4ba)yin gsung*/ lar zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu tshun chad 'od gsal de ltar bsgom/ zhag bdun bdun na rnam rtog re re ldang bas de'i dus su 'dun pa drag po bsgom/ de bzhin du byas pas sangs rgya'o/// /gsum pa mngal gyi grong khyer dgag pa ni/ der rnam par rtog pa byung nas lus len pa'i dus su/ pha ma gnyis la chags sdang gnyis kyi lus len pas/ pha de da lta'i rdo rje slob dpon du bsgom/ ma de rdo rje slob dpon gyi jo mor bsgom/ rang de'i dus su yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms la 'od gsal gyi ngang la bzhag go /des kyang mi khegs pa 'dra na rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma yin chags rgyu ci yod snyam du bsgom mo// des 'bring bar dor sangs rgya ba'o// de la bla ma'i zhal nas/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu khegs pa ni// 'khor ba'i srid pa khegs pa yin// zhes gsungs/ des kyang mi khegs na/ da cis kyang lus len par 'dug na/ de'i dus su sems la dbang thob pa lta bu 'ong ba yin pas/

lus bdam ste/ paṇḍi ta dang 'khor lo'i sgyur rgyal la sogs pa/ sems can gyi don nus pa cig gi lus blangs la sngar gyi 'od gsal bsgom mo// de ni skye ba brgyud pas sangs rgya ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/// /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'pho ba la gsum/ rab 'od gsal/ 'bring sgyu lus/ tha ma bskyed rim gyis 'pho ba'o// de la 'od gsal gyis 'pho ba ni/ rang la 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa yod pa cig 'chi ba'i dus su/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i 'od gsal la ma yengs par byas nas 'chi ba yin te/ de la 'pho rgyu med kyang 'pho bar ming btags pa yin/ 'bring sgyu lus kyis 'pho ba ni/ de ltar bsgom pa'i dus su rang gi gnas 'di sum cu rtsa gsum ar mo li ka'i rdo leb kyi steng yin par bsam la/ de nas bsgom par bya'o// gnyid kyi dus su (5na)yang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin la der bsgom pa'i 'dun pa bya'o// de ltar byas pas/ rmi lam du sum cu rtsa gsum du bsgom pa rmi/ mngon par dga' ba'i 'pho ba bya ba yin pas/ de 'chi ba'i dus su sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas ar mo li ka'i rdo leb ces bya ba/ mnan na nem byed dang*/ bteg na phar byed pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyis bcag pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der phyin la/ der phyag rgya chen po bsgom snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang bas/ shes pa sum cu rtsa gsum du 'phos nas dbugs 'gags/ lus bzhag pa'o// der bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa'o// tha ma bskyed rim gyis 'pho ba ni/ rang yi dam lhar bsam la/ lte bar āḥsnying khar hūṃ/ tshangs bug tu kṣam̐yu bsam la/ de nas rlung bum pa can du byas ste/ āḥde yar song hūm̐ la bstim/ hūṃ yar song bas/ kṣam̐yu de 'bur 'bur 'phul bar bsam/ de nas yang mar la phab la so sor bzhag /de ltar byang bar byas la/ nam 'chi rtags byung ba dang*/ der 'pho ba'i dus su mdun gyi nam mkha' la yi dam lha bsam la/

āḥyar hūṃ la bstims la/ spyi bo'i kṣam̐yu gsal la tshangs bug har gyis song bar bsam la/ ngag tu āḥhig tu brjod la/ hūṃ de yar la tshegs med du ston la/ yi dam lha'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ de ltar yang yang byas pas nges par 'pho ba'o// de ni rab 'od gsal/ 'bring sgyu lus/ tha ma bskyed rim gyis 'pho ba gsum mo// da ni btsan thabs kyis 'pho ba la/ pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs/ lag pa gnyis ltag khung du sbrel/ rked pa dbyug pa la bkal la/ snying gyen la log gis log par bsam la/ ngag tu hikka drag tu brjod pas/ (5ba)nges par bde ba can du 'pho gsung*/ yang gnyid ma zlog par/ snying khar hūṃ gcig bsam la/ tshangs bug gong bzhin bsam la/ de nas hūṃ de ljur te thon nas yi dam lha'i thugs kar thim par bsam pa'am/ yang na bde ba can du song bar bsam nas/ ngag tu hikka drag tu brjod pas 'pho gsung ngo*// rlung sbyang ba'i thabs ni/ stan bde ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung bca'/ sgal pa bsrang*/ o sko bkug /lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte ba'i 'og tu bzhag ste/ dang po phyir 'gro nang 'gro kha cig byas nas/ rlung gnas su bzhag ste/ de nas rlung nang du rdzogs par blangs la thub tshad bzung ngo*// de zhag bco lnga nyi shu'i bar du bsgoms pas/ rlung nang du yun ring du thub pa snyam byed na/ rang gis rlung bzung ste grogs cig rtsar bzhag la/ phreng ba la kho'i rlung bgrang du bcug ste/ de nas rang gi rlung ma thub na btang ba dang mnyam du/ grogs kyis kyang phreng ba bzhag ste/ phreng ba de la sum cu rtsa drug them 'dug na des chog /lhag na skyon med/ chad na zhag gcig pa cig bsgom/ de ltar rlung sum cu rtsa drug khegs pa dang 'pho ba sbyang*/ des ni rlung sbyang ba'i man ngag rdzogs so/// /de nas rlung 'byongs nas/ yang lus bcos/ rang lha skur gsal ba'i spyi bo tshang bug tu kṣam̐yu / mig gnyis su hūṃ/

smin mtshams su hūṃ/ rna ba gnyis dang*/ sna bug gnyis su yam̐ re re/ khar sum/ lte bar hūṃ/ bshang gci'i lam du kṣam̐yu / yi ge rnams kha dog dkar por bsam ste/ de ltar sgo dgu yi ge dgus bkag nas rlung nang du bstim ste/ lte ba na sems kyi rgyal po ar gnas te/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ hikka re re la de yar byung bas klad pa'i steng*/ (6na)thod pa'i 'og tu yar drang ngo*// de yang phreng rdog nyi shu rtsa gcig la bgrang ste/ de la tha ma mi 'chos/ de nas yang rlung bstim ste/ phreng ba la hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ lte bar āḥde mar dbab bo// de nas yang rlung btang ste ngal en cig bso'o// de ka bzhin yar 'dren pa lhag par yang yang bsgom mo// thun 'jog na/ spyi bor mi bzhag par lte bar phab la/ de nas thun mtshams bya'o// de 'dra zhag bdun bsgoms pas/ 'pho ba 'byongs te/ 'byongs pa'i rtags lnga ni/ lto che ba/ dpral ba na phar tsha ba'am/ rngul tsha ba 'char ba 'byung ngo*// 'tshog ma tog ste 'gro ba lta bu byung na 'byongs pa yin/ zhes bla ma gsung ste/ de mi dgos par/ rlung bstims la bde mor yar 'gro mar 'gro 'ong nas 'byongs pa yin/ de ltar 'byongs pa de lo nyi shu tsam na byas nas/ de nas bzhag ste/ lo lnga bcu drug cu tsam na 'chi ba'i dus 'phos pas chog gsung*/ de ltar gdan bzhi las/ rngub pa sngon du brtsams nas ni// thams cad du ni dgag par bya// zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig dbugs dag gis// gnas nas drag tu drangs nas su// tshigs gcig nas ni tshigs gcig go /tshigs dgu gong ma'i bar du'o// yar ldog mar ldog sa bon gyis// sbyang bya'i yi ge phyed dang gnyis// nga ro drag tu brjod pa yis// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no// 'pho ba 'byongs nas/ phyis 'chi ba'i dus su 'pho ba bya ste/ de yang gdan bzhi las/ 'chi ba'i mtshan ma mthong nas ni// 'chi bar gyur pa'i dus byung nas// rims la sogs pa ma phog par// 'pho ba sbyong ba mchog yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i don/

gnas khang yid dang mthun par/ yi (6ba)dam lha'i sku lugs ma'am/ ras bris bzhugs su gzhug /me tog la sogs pa ci 'byor ba dang gtor ma bshams la/ ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang*/ yi dam lha dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs la/ de rnams la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma ci 'byor ba phul/ de nas rang stan bde ba la skyil krung bcas la/ sgal pa bsrang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bya ste/ lha'i skur bsgom/ sgo dgu yi ge dgus dgag /der rlung bstim mi dgos/ lte ba'i a de gong bzhin/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig gis yar drangs/ de nas yar mar lte bar dbab/ de ni nyams sad pa'o// de nas spyi bo'i

kṣam̐yu de gsal te/ spyi bor har gyis song bar bsam la/ de nas rkang mthil gnyis su yam̐ yig re re bsam/ de dku g.yas g.yon gnyis dang*/ mchan khung gnyis yam̐ re re/ snying gar yang yam̐ bzhis bskor bar bsam/ de nas yam̐ de rnams las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bcu gzhu'i dbyibs su 'dug pa/ 'ur sgra dang bcas pas sems kyi rgyal po a bteg ste 'dug par bsam la/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig gis shin tu drag par drangs te/ spyi bo nas aḥde rgyangs kyis song bar bsam la/ yi dam lha'i thugs kar shes pa gtad/ des mi 'pho na/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gsum rtsa bzhi rtsa lnga brjod pas mi 'pho mi srid do// de yang gdan bzhi las/ lus la rlung gi kha dog dang*// hūm̐ gi sa bon drug pa ru// rlung gis mtha' yi rtsa bar ni// sa bon sems kyis drang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bshad rgyud las kyang*/ hūṃ gi nga ro drag po yis// lus can rnams ni bkol bar bya// zhes gsungs so/ de ltar 'phos pas/ rlung sems tshangs pa'i bu ga nas phyur ru ru 'byung gsung ngo*// des ni bar dor (7na)sangs rgya'o// de yang gdan bzhi las/ de bzhin 'das pa'i lus dag las// ye shes lnga ni rang dgar 'byung*// zhes gsungs so// sbyangs nas 'pho ba'i man ngag go// /na mo gu ru/ gnyid 'od gsal du gzhug pa ni/ do nub rmi lam mi rmi bar/ gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal bsgom dgos snyam nas/ rang gi snying kar padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūṃ bsam nas/ de la shes pa gtad nas gnyid log go /gnyid sad pa dang*/ da ci yang gnyid 'od gsal du ma tshud par 'dug /da ci nas kyang gnyid 'od gsal du bsgom dgos snyam nas/ gnyid log pas gnyid dus su 'od gsal ngos zin nas/ gnyid log ma log med par 'od gsal du 'byung ngo*// de yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ yang na 'od gsal ba la bzhag /bya ba gnyid mi log pa'i dus rang nas 'od gsal la bzhag nas bsgom pa lugs gcig yin no// de nas gnyid log ma log med par 'od gsal du 'byung ba yin te/

gang zag cig gzhan gang la yang mi rten par gnyid kyi sgo nas sangs rgya ba'o// gnyid 'od gsal du gzhug pa'i man ngag go// /mngal du sems can chags pa ni/ pha ma gnyis kyis sngar de chags pa'i las bsags pa las lhag ma de dus dang ldan zhing*/ zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang*/ pha ma gnyis 'dod chags langs nas phrad pa dang*/ dri za nye bar 'khor ba las/ mngal chags par chos mngon pa nas bshad do// phyi ma'i lus kyi snang ba/ bsam pa thams cad tshang ba/ mngal dang*/ sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can// dbang po rdo rje gdan gnyis ma gtogs gzhan gang la mi thogs/ bar do rang nang phan tshun lha'i mig gis mthong bar bshad/ kun tshang thogs med rgyu// rigs mthun lha mig (7ba)dag pas mthong*// zas su mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ de ni dri za'o// blo ni phyin ci log sngon phyin ci log la goms pas/ skye ba len pa la padma'i mtsho la ngang mo rtse ba ltar 'gro ba'o/ gyur pas// rtse dgas 'gro ba'i yul du 'gro /zhes slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis gsungs so/// /na mo gu ru/ sgyu lus sbyang ba 'di ltar bya ste/ gnyid sad pa'i dus su rjes thob la bdag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang dang snang ba thams cad mnyam bzhag rmi lam gyi dus su snang ba bzhin/ thams cad sgyu ma'am/ chu zla lta bur byas shing bsgom/ de la de bzhin bsgoms pas ye shes 'char ro// yang gnyid sad nas rjes thob la 'di ltar bsgom ste/ rang tha mal gyi lus me long la gsal ba ltar bltas la/ me long mdun du rang la bstan nas yid yul du blta zhing gsal bar bsgom mo// de gsal por bstan nas/ de la yon tan mang du brjod de bstod pas/ de la dga' ba'i sems mi 'byung ste/ sgyu lus yin pas so// yang skabs su de la ngan gyi bye brag mang du brjod de smad pas/ de la mi dga' ba'i sems mi 'byung ngo*// de ltar lan mang du bsgom zhing shin tu brtan nas/ yang de rang gi lus la gzhug cing*/

rang nyid sgyu ma'i lus la bstod pas dga' ba med/ smad pas mi dga' ba med pa'i lus su bsgom/ de la gsal du ma 'dod na/ mdun du yang bsgoms la/ yang lus la gzhug cing bsgom mo// rang yi dam gyi lhar byas la bstod ra mang du btang ngo*// de la dga' ba mi skye na/ rang gi lus la gzhug go /des ni nges par sgyu ma'am/ chu zla la sogs pa'i lus su mthong ba 'ong la/ rang gi mngon zhen log nas/ snang ba thams cad kyi zhen pa ldog pa la tshegs med cing*/ snang ba thams cad kyang sgyu (8na)ma'i rnam par long long mthong bar 'gyur te/ tha mal gyi snang ba rnams thams cad mi 'byung ngo*// de dus rang dang snang ba thams cad sgyu mar grub pas/ ji ltar yang bsgyur du 'dod de/ gnyid kyi dus su/ sad pa'i dus nyid dang dbyer med du phral le gnas pa ni/ gnyid log ma log dbyer med pa zhes bya'o// sgyu lus kyi man ngag /bkra shis so/// /na mo gu ru/ grong 'jug 'pho ba'i man ngag la/ gnas dben par maṇḍal la sogs pa byas la/ thod pa zhig la snag tsha la sogs pa'i rtsi nag po zhig legs par byugs la/ de la hūm̐ dkar po gcig bris pa ras bal gyis g.yogs pa maṇḍal gyi khar bzhag /de nas rang gi snying gar hūṃ gcig bsam la/ de brtan pa dang*/ hūṃ de phar 'phos thod pa'i hūṃ la bstims la/ de la shes pa gtad la bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas thod pa'i hūṃ la shes pa zin pa'i rtags/ thod pa 'gro ba'am/ 'gul ba'am/ 'tsheg pa'am/ ras bal 'gul ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar byung nas/ srog chags phra mo re'u lug gu'am/ bya la sogs pa'i ro rma med pa/ ma rul ba cig blangs la/ de'i snying gar hūṃ bsam la/ de la shes pa gtad la bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas/ ro de 'gul ba dang*/ ldang nus pa byung na/ grong 'jug nus pa yin pas/ yul khams gzhan cig tu phyin la/ rgyal po'i bu'am/ gzhon nu ma dar chas pa zhig gi ro/ rul sungs dang*/

rma med pa/ 'khrug pas shi ba ma yin pa/ skyugs nas shi ba ma yin pa/ rims la sogs pas shi ba ma yin pa'i ro blangs la/ khrus legs par byas la/ tsandan la sogs pa'i dri bzang pos byugs/ ras la sogs pa'i gos bzang po (8ba)bskon/ gser g.yu la sogs pa'i rgyan bzang pos brgyan la/ yid 'jug par byas la/ maṇḍal gyi dbus su bzhag nas/ rang dang kha sprad de/ ro'i sna bug g.yas pa dang*/ rang gi sna bug g.yon pa gnyis sprad la/ ro'i snying gar hūṃ bsam la/ de la shes pa gtad la bsgom/ rang gi lus rgas pa de la mi bsam/ yang yang ro la shes pa ma yengs par bsgom/ de ltar yun ring du byas pas ro la shes pa chags nas langs nas sngar gyi lus rgas pa la sogs pa de bsdu ba sogs byas nas/ de nas sems can gyi don bya ba yin gsungs so/// /na mo gu ru/ spyir sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ba la/ dang po rmi lam yongs su bzung ba dang*/ rmi lam spel ba dang*/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa/ thams cad la ya nga ba spangs te/ rtogs pa phul du dbyung ba'o// de la skyon bzhi 'byung ste/ 'byams pa gol ba'i tshad/ nyon mongs ldang ba'i ro/ ye shes su sleb pa'i tshad/ 'khor bar ldog pa'i dus so// de la dang po ni/ zhag grangs ci rigs par bya ba thams cad btang*/ ngal dub spang*/ kha zas cha mnyam par bya/ nyin par bsgom zhing*/ bdag gis do nub rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya/ nyal khar mi btang bar mgrin par/ padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ 'dab ma rnams la/ a nu ta ra/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru dkar po g.yon skor du bkod nas/ cung zad cig yi ge lnga la shes pa gtad/ mthar oṃ la gtad/ de nas gnyid log /de bzhin du zhag grangs ci rigs pa bya'o// g.yang dang chu la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dgras ded pa rmi na zin 'dod pa'i rtags so// gnad zin nas/ g.yang la sogs (9na)pa rmi ba na/

'di rmi lam yin snyam du ngo shes pa 'byung ste/ de ni rmi lam zin pa yin no// de nas cher zin nas/ sems la dga' ba/ lus la bde ba rgyas pa 'ongs te/ rmi lam lta bu zhag 'ga' 'byung ba yod do// gnad dang po de ru ma zin na/ 'byams pa gol ba bya ba yin pas/ sngon 'gro rnams 'dra bar byas la mgrin par mi bzung bar/ mdzod spur thig le dkar po gcig la nyal khar shes pa gtad/ des ma zin na/ thig le nag por bsgyur te de la gtad nas bzung*/ des ma zin na/ cher 'byams pa bya ba yin pas/ gnyid che na/ zas cung zad dbri/ gos bsrab/ rmi lam 'ong yang mi zin na/ nyin par lung stong nyams dga' ba/ mi med pa'i sar phyin la/ gcer bur rgyug cing skad chen po 'bod/ de ltar nyin re lan gsum bzhi bya/ de nas g.yang yod pa'i sar 'jigs su gzhug /de nas mtshan mo rang gi gnas su 'dug ste/ nyal khar lus 'di phyin ci log tu 'dug ste/ nyal khar mdzod spur thig le nag po bsgoms la/ de la shes pa gtad/ nub dang po nyid nas zin/ shin tu sbyang dka' na yang nub gsum nas zin no// de nas zhag grangs ci rigs par sbyang*/ de rang ngo shes shing mi 'tsham pa sna tshogs byung na spel te/ khyi lta bu rmi na/ khyi brgya phrag gam/ khyi re re la yang dpag tu med par bsam la/ bdag gi lus kyang mang por bya ste/ res 'ga' nyi zla rdog pas mnan cing*/ rgya mtsho'i gting du 'gro ba dang*/ ri rab kyi rtse mnan pa sogs du ma bya'o// de ni rmi lam spel te ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad sems su rtogs pa dang*/ sems nyid kyang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar yin kyang bde stong gi nyams chung na/ srid pa (9ba)las mi grol zhing de nyid la zhen pa skye bas rmi lam gyi rgyas btab ste/ nyal khar mdzod spur thig le dkar la gsal ba/ bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa bsgoms la/ de rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po'i nang du bsgyur bar bya'o// skabs su dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong yang dran par bya'o// des bde ba shugs cher 'bar zhing*/

ting nge 'dzin gyis brgyal ba 'byung bas/ 'di nyid/ bsam gtan ro la yon tan ldan// zhes kyang bya'o// de la chags na/ nyon mongs pa gzhan yang skye la/ las kyang bsags nas 'khor bar skye bas/ nyon mongs pa ldang ba'i ro yin no// de yang khang pa cung zad yangs pa nag par/ rang gi snying kar khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ mig 'bras gyen la bzlog /shes pa lhug par bzhag la/ bde ba la stong pas rgyas thebs na phyag rgya chen po mchog rtogs so// skabs su tshangs pa'i sgo yi bu ga shin tu phra bar cung zad tsam re gtad de/ mig kyang nang du bzlog /des kyang bde stong mchog skye'o// 'di ni ye shes sleb pa'i tshad ces bya ba yin no// de tsa na chos thams cad sems su shes shing*/ de yang sgyu ma'am/ rmi lam lta bur shes la/ de yang bde stong mchog rtogs pa'o// da rung yang 'khor bar skyes kyis dogs te ya nga ba dang*/ thar pa ma thob kyi dogs pa dang bral bas/ de'i ya nga ba spang zhing*/ rtogs pa mchog tu bya ba ni/ spyod lam dang bsre ba yin te/ gzugs la sogs pa gang mthong ba thams cad la/ bdag nyid kyi nyams de dran par bya ste/ yul sna tshogs pa la g.yeng zhing goms par bya'o// mthar mnyam rjes med par/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams dang rtogs pa phul du phyin pa 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin brtan yang*/ 'chi ba'i rkyen byas nas (10na)bar dor lus len srid de/ gal te lus blangs na ni/ 'khor bar ldog pa'i dus shes bya ba yin/ 'di yi gnad ni/ dang po 'phang zhing 'du shes btang*// zhes pa yin te/ bar do sgyu lus la sgyu lus su ngo shes par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa skabs su btang zhing*/ rmi lam nyid don du gnyer te/ rmi lam spel ba sogs ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'ong la/ de mnyam rjes med na/ bar dor sgyu lus thebs te/ bar do nyid mchog gi lus te/ sku 'grub par bzhed do// 'di nyid la/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis sgyu lus la bstod pa/

khong stong khyod kyi sku la med// ces sogs che ba'i yon tan gyi bshad pa yang mdzad/ de ltar rmi lam dang*/ sgyu lus man ngag gi gnad bsdus pa yin no// yig tho las ni/ gnad ma 'khrul pa bya tsam las ma gsungs so/// /chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang rtogs pa yis// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// sku lnga yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas myur grub shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /maṅga laṃ bha wantu//
